summary: Daily rewards for any game: a login calendar that greets the player once per session.
description: A ready daily rewards screen for ANY game, built on the @idosgames/react/ui kit and client.reward. A daily login calendar (collected / today / locked cards, the last day a big milestone) that pops up by itself once per session while a reward is waiting (like DailyBonusAutoOpener in the Unity project). Registers the 'rewards' feature; its badge shows the daily bonus waiting. Quests are the quests system. Ships title-seed.json: a 7-day calendar.
provides: badge for the waiting daily bonus
